# SD13-E5 deterministic Human Bard level 10 progression fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD13-E4/E5 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Bard
# level-1/level-2/level-3/level-4/level-5/level-6/level-7 spontaneous arcane
# spell-bearing baseline to level 10 as chosen input only. It names
# selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or parity values. It
# preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam (ability-bonus and
# bonus-feat), the deterministic ability/feat/performance posture from the
# level-1 through level-7 fixtures, adding only the level bump this bounded
# tranche needs.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Bard burden surface: no performance-state
# engine (start/maintain action economy, round tracking/consumption), no
# Countersong or Distraction, no Versatile Performance execution (including
# the additional Perform-type substitution the PF1 Core Rulebook grants at
# 6th level), no Suggestion execution (the PF1 Core Rulebook's 6th-level Bard
# class feature, checked against a primary source and confirmed NOT flat —
# it requires a fascinated-target prerequisite, the performance-state
# engine, and the "suggestion" spell-like-ability's own effect resolution,
# none of which exist in this codebase), no Dirge of Doom execution (the PF1
# Core Rulebook's 8th-level Bard class feature, checked against two primary
# sources and confirmed NOT flat — it is a new bardic-performance type
# requiring the same performance-state engine plus a fear/shaken-condition
# resolution engine, neither of which exist in this codebase), no Inspire
# Greatness execution (stays named-but-unproven exactly as the level-9 slice
# left it), no repeat Versatile Performance recognition (the level-10
# "Special" column's second entry, the same choice-list feature left
# unproven at 2nd/6th), no untrained-skill-use execution for the newly
# recognized Jack-of-All-Trades grant (the level-10 "Special" column's first
# entry, "the bard can use any skill, even if the skill normally requires
# him to be trained" — a genuinely flat no-choice grant grounded as a +0
# identity record only, mirroring the Woodland Stride/Purity of Body
# precedent; its 16th/19th-level tiers land beyond the tranche ceiling), no Lore
# Master take-10/take-20 execution against any actual Knowledge check, and no
# spontaneous known-spell / slot posture burden.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-bard-level10
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:bard:10
ability=strength:10
ability=dexterity:14
ability=constitution:12
ability=intelligence:13
ability=wisdom:8
ability=charisma:15
feat=feat:dodge
choice=choice:bard_bardic_knowledge:flag:enabled
choice=choice:bard_bardic_music:performance:inspire_courage
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:charisma
